reported_metrics.note: Stage748 C50 logic, but if the latest completed daily bar has OI up and price aligned with the trade direction, entry risk is doubled on top of the Stage748 0.40 risk ratio, which restores effective formal risk from 0.40 to 0.80. | Research-only AM40 minimum. AM=41 because signal compares current and previous MA40. | Stage804 yearly validation. For long entries only, use max(signal_day_low, close*(1-stop_loss_pct)) as the initial stop. | Stage813 corrected RSI ablation. enable_rsi_partial_exit=True. | Stage825 read-only intraday forensics. source=official_candidate_stage819_30w_am41_oi08_old_ai_long_tighter_stop_rsi95_v1. | Stage827 isolated strategy subclass. C2 intraday first-1R stop is enabled only for the C arm. | Stage830 live-feasible account guard. C2 intraday stop remains enabled; flat-entry sizing is reduced when projected broker10 margin/equity would exceed 100%; reverse-entry is fail-closed to close-only rather than immediately reopening in the opposite direction. | Stage847 frozen C9. After C4 entry, if entry-day price first hits 0.5R adverse before 0.5R progress, synthesize a -0.5R stop. If price later reclaims the original entry level on the same entry day, reopen once at the original entry price; if the retry again hits 0.5R adverse the same day, close and do not retry again. | Stage901 official live default operator override. C9 is promoted to live default by explicit operator request; no parameter search.

unfilled_plan_diagnostics.explanation: on_bars first rebalance submits target; forced_margin_deleverage reduces provisional state target; second rebalance cancel_all cancels new unfilled order, then submits actual-pos-to-target delta. Entry signal_order_id is only populated by actual on_trade sync. Candidate opened means admitted plan, not fill. Inherited from frozen L (6 full cancellations); no real fills manufactured.

position_limit_diagnostics.distinction: Intraday here is modeled fill-clock order, not verified minute execution. Daily-close positions can be lower.

former_L_23_concurrent_candidates.note: Observed M ledger episodes only. Their sum does not measure marginal alpha; M changes all equity/slots/risk sizing paths.

other_risk_constraints.event_counts_overlap_warning: ATR and sizing and forced events are stages, not additive distinct rejected trades. Forced events include provisional reductions/cancellations.

comparison.interpretation: One count-cap ablation in a coupled account. Observed former-23 and signal-ledger PnL are accounting decompositions, not independent causal alpha.
